verdict.rationale: Chat notifications are a fair question for a code-hosting product like Bitbucket, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents sending repository or pull request notifications to Slack, Discord, Teams, or any other chat tool. The partner-integrations claim lists AI, security, testing and monitoring but not chat, and "build custom integrations" is only a developer building block. The community mention of using free HipChat alongside Bitbucket describes a user arrangement, not a documented notification feature.
